pages.title: Quantum Hall Effect
pages.text: $(thing)Quantum Hall Effect$()$(br2)Electrons in a sheet at low temperature and strong field fill Landau levels; the Hall resistance locks onto plateaus at h/(νe²), exact to a part in a billion - because it counts a topological invariant. Unlocks Hall Bar Chips.
$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Room-Temperature Superconductivity, Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Silicon Boule, 2 Laue Pattern.
